current_runtime_surfaces.production_hook_registry_selector_source: crates/bitnet-models/src/bitnet.rs:dense_q8_runtime_hooks_from_sidecars sets receipt_bound_no_bias_selector=None for every sidecar descriptor

why_dispatch_is_not_wired_in_this_slice: The required receipt-bound selector is not attached to the production DenseLinearRuntimeHookRegistry.
The model-load hook registry is built before warm-session prompt IDs, generated IDs, and decoded text digests exist.
FeedForward::apply_linear receives only the hook registry and linear callsite inputs; it has no prompt/session receipt identity argument.
Adding a dispatch branch now would either never execute because the selector is None, or would require stale/global identity that is not bound to the current prompt receipt.

safe_next_designs.description: Attach a receipt-bound selector to the model/session hook registry after prompt digests exist and before same-prompt candidate execution, with prompt isolation and stale-identity clearing.
Avoid mutating model hooks; pass a prompt-bound candidate execution descriptor to FeedForward::apply_linear for the exact callsite and emit candidate off/on evidence there.
